title: (RHBA-2020:0545) Red Hat support for Spring Boot 2.1.12 update
portal_summary: An update is now available for Red Hat support for Spring Boot.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat support for Spring Boot 2.1.12 update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Application Runtimes|Red Hat Openshift Application Runtimes|Text-Only Advisories|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying the update, back up your existing installation, including all applications, configuration files, databases and database settings, and so on.

The References section of this erratum contains a download link (you must log in to download the update).
portal_description:
Red Hat support for Spring Boot provides an application platform that reduces the complexity of developing and operating applications (monoliths and microservices) for OpenShift as a containerized platform.

This release of Red Hat support for Spring Boot 2.1.12 serves as a replacement for Red Hat support for Spring Boot 2.1.6, and includes security and bug fixes and enhancements. For further information, refer to the release notes linked to in the References section.

In particular, the following security issue was fixed:

- CVE-2020-5398: RFD Attack via “Content-Disposition” Header Sourced from Request Input by Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux Application
